Press Kit: Advancing AI 2026
AMD brings together developers, partners, customers and enterprise leaders at its flagship global AI event.
AMD showcased the latest advancements in AI solutions and high-performance computing on July 23, 2026, in San Francisco at its flagship global event, Advancing AI 2026. AMD leaders joined developers, customers, enterprise leaders and partners to offer blueprints for building, deploying and scaling AI using AMD technology.
At the event keynote, AMD Chair and CEO Dr. Lisa Su announced a broad portfolio of end-to-end AI solutions. From silicon to software, AMD showed how it is reshaping the AI and high-performance computing landscape.
